_comment: Recursion-termination guard, rejection path (temporal-workflow.md, 'Resolved: Recursion Termination Guard'), on the flat reason-act loop. turn:1 spawns a subagent; that subagent tries to hand its ENTIRE task to a further subagent with no delegated_scope/kept_work -> rejected at mint time (no <turn:1>:sub:1:sub:1 child workflow ever starts, durably recorded as a tool_calls error). The has_tool_calls fix: the subagent must loop back for a follow-up reasoning step to react to the rejection rather than silently ending its turn.
